description: Switch the agent runtime by selecting a declared route (purpose category). The route picks the provider, model, and reasoning effort from the config-declared catalog with health-checked fallbacks — these are not model inputs. All switches are session-scoped and persist until /new. Global config changes are intentionally unsupported.
name: model_switch

reason.description: Short explanation for why the route switch is needed.

route.description: Target route (purpose category) from the declared catalog.
